presets.name: coin_burst
presets.summary: Gold coins-and-glints burst that pops up and falls back, for collecting money.
presets.use: Fire it where a coin or cash pickup is collected, or over a player when they earn money.

presets.name: sparkle_shimmer
presets.summary: A slow shimmer of twinkling stars around an object — rare, shiny, worth grabbing.
presets.use: On rare items, legendary pets, shop highlights, chests and anything that should read as valuable.

presets.name: level_up_aura
presets.summary: Golden light rising around a player in a column, with a ring pulse at the feet.
presets.use: Parent to the HumanoidRootPart (or a part) when a player levels up; remove after a few seconds.

presets.name: rebirth_pillar
presets.summary: A tall pillar of light from the ground into the sky, with energy streaming up it.
presets.use: Rebirth / prestige moments, spawn points, quest beacons. Parent to a part on the ground.

presets.name: fire
presets.summary: Warm licking flames with embers and their own flickering light.
presets.use: Campfires, torches, braziers, burning wrecks. Parent to the burning part.

presets.name: smoke
presets.summary: Slow grey smoke that billows up and widens.
presets.use: Chimneys, wrecks, extinguished fires, factory stacks.

presets.name: explosion
presets.summary: Fireball, shockwave ring, flying sparks and rolling smoke — a full explosion without the physics.
presets.use: Bombs, destroyed objects, rockets, boss deaths. Fire it once; it does no damage by itself.

presets.name: magic_hit
presets.summary: A violet arcane impact: bright flash, expanding rune ring and glittering shards.
presets.use: Where a spell, magic projectile or special ability lands.

presets.name: heal
presets.summary: Soft green motes and sparkles drifting up around a player.
presets.use: Healing zones, potions, regen buffs, safe zones. Parent to the player root or a pad.

presets.name: portal
presets.summary: A swirling vortex disc with particles spiralling in and a glowing rim.
presets.use: Teleporters, world gates, obby checkpoints to a new area. Parent to a thin upright part (the doorway).

presets.name: water_splash
presets.summary: A crown of droplets thrown up and falling back, with a ripple ring on the surface.
presets.use: Something landing in water, a player jumping into a pool, fountains, water balloons.

presets.name: dust_trail
presets.summary: Brown dust puffs kicked up behind something moving along the ground.
presets.use: Parent to a vehicle wheel, a running pet or a player foot; puffs stay behind as it moves.

presets.name: speed_trail
presets.summary: A glowing ribbon that streams behind a moving object and fades out.
presets.use: Sprint and dash abilities, speed pads, swords, fast pets, racing cars. Parent to the moving part.

presets.name: confetti
presets.summary: Coloured paper squares fired up that tumble and flutter down.
presets.use: Wins, finishing an obby, unlocking a badge, birthdays, the end of a round.

presets.name: pet_hatch
presets.summary: The egg-opening moment: white-gold flash, a double ring pulse and a shower of stars.
presets.use: When an egg hatches or a gacha/capsule reveals its prize.

presets.name: egg_glow
presets.summary: A soft glowing outline and aura around an egg, with a slow sparkle — "open me".
presets.use: Eggs in a hatch shop, rare eggs, mystery boxes. Parent to the egg part or model.

presets.name: lightning
presets.summary: A jagged blue-white bolt from the sky to the ground, with a strike flash and sparks.
presets.use: Storm maps, lightning abilities, boss attacks, electric traps. Parent to the part that gets struck.

presets.name: snow
presets.summary: Gentle snowflakes drifting down over an area.
presets.use: Winter maps and holiday events. Parent to a large invisible part above the area, or to Workspace to get one made.

presets.name: rain
presets.summary: Falling rain streaks over an area.
presets.use: Stormy and moody maps. Parent to a large invisible part above the area, or to Workspace to get one made. Pair with a rain ambience sound.

presets.name: fireflies
presets.summary: Small yellow-green lights wandering and blinking at dusk.
presets.use: Night forests, meadows, swamps, camp scenes. Parent to a low invisible part over the area, or to Workspace.

presets.name: hit_sparks
presets.summary: A quick white-orange spark spray and flash — a weapon or punch landing.
presets.use: Sword hits, punches, bullets hitting metal, critical hits.

presets.name: select_highlight
presets.summary: A clean coloured outline on a model or part, visible through walls.
presets.use: Hover/selection feedback, interactable objects, a quest target, the player's own team.
